title: Record the ordinary-rate coefficient gap
body:
## Summary
- With `c = 1/577`, the factor `17/16` composes to `4283584`. The bounds written on line 156 replace that factor by 2 and give `8033584`.
- The witness `n = 1023683` at `e = 2^20` exceeds the stated line-158 bound by more than `17/16`. No moment rerun and no new kappa.
